caption:
Mr Turtle loves time with his grandkids, but getting up off the floor and lifting the little ones is getting harder.

Playing with grandkids is a mix of sitting, standing, lifting and balancing. At any age, these everyday moves can often be built up with regular, gentle practice.

Hybi's tip: practise sit to stand from a chair, try heel raises and one-leg balance while holding support, and lift the grandkids with bent knees, close to your body.

A recent fall, frequent dizziness or pain that isn't settling are worth an assessment. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD physio-led clinical Pilates team can help. Book online via the link in bio
